lanes.name: Home
lanes.note: Today at a glance. Widgets you can rearrange; each one opens the page behind it.

lanes.name: Log button
lanes.note: The round button on every tab. One tap to log a climb, a weigh-in, a note, or to start a session.

lanes.name: Train
lanes.note: Plans, the exercise library and the weekly schedule. Starting a plan opens the live session.

lanes.name: Live session
lanes.tab: From Train or the Log menu
lanes.note: A running workout or climbing day. It keeps running when you leave the screen, with a pill above the tab bar and a live notification.

lanes.name: Journal
lanes.note: One timeline of climbs, sessions, results and notes, with search and filters.

lanes.name: Progress
lanes.note: How climbing and training are going.

lanes.name: You
lanes.note: Your profile, body, places and settings.

lanes.name: Other states
lanes.tab: The same pages with other settings
lanes.note: Light theme, the largest text size, another accent colour, and Home before there is any data.

pages.title: Home
pages.desc: The dashboard: today’s plan from your weekly schedule, climbs and days this week, latest best, bodyweight, open projects and recent climbs. Tapping a project or a recent climb opens its log.

pages.title: Home, lower half
pages.desc: Open projects with their goes, and your recent climbs with a link to the Journal.

pages.title: Edit dashboard
pages.desc: Edit mode: drag widgets to move them, resize them or remove them.

pages.title: Add widget
pages.desc: The widget list: Today’s plan, This week, Days on the wall, Latest best, Bodyweight, Weight trend, Sends per week, Sends by style, Recent climbs, Projects, Consistency, Training and Exercise.

pages.title: Choose what to show
pages.desc: The Training and Exercise widgets ask what to show: a training figure (on plan, sessions, sets, time or new bests) or one exercise.

pages.title: Climbs this week
pages.desc: Every climb of the week, with a week picker and totals for climbs, sends and hardest.

pages.title: Days on the wall
pages.desc: A calendar of the days you climbed, with week, month and year counts and your week streak.

pages.title: Log menu
pages.desc: What did you do? Log climb, Log weight, Start a session, Add a note.

pages.title: Log climb
pages.desc: Where, climb type, grade strip, the day, goes (+ Fell, + Sent), how hard it felt, name, note, photo and video. When a session is running, the climb joins it.

pages.title: Log climb, lower half
pages.desc: Effort, name, note and the photo and video buttons, then Log climb.

pages.title: Where
pages.desc: Pick a saved place, then a facility and wall, then a problem. Or skip and log without a place.

pages.title: New place
pages.desc: Name a new place and pick its type without leaving Log climb.

pages.title: Pick the day
pages.desc: A calendar for logging a climb on an earlier day.

pages.title: Log weight
pages.desc: The day strip and a ruler for today’s bodyweight sit at the bottom, within reach of your thumb, with the change since your last weigh-in.

pages.title: New note
pages.desc: Write a thought, a niggle or beta, with an optional tag.

pages.title: Where, wall step
pages.desc: After the place, pick the wall or facility. A problem on the wall fills in its grade.

pages.title: Edit log
pages.desc: A logged climb in the same form as Log climb, with Save changes and Delete. Opening a project from Home or Progress lands here when you already logged it today.

pages.title: Delete this log?
pages.desc: Asks before a logged climb is deleted.

pages.title: Type a value
pages.desc: Rulers, wheels and steppers all open a number pad when you tap the value, so you can type it instead.

pages.title: Note
pages.desc: Edit a note: tag, text, pin or delete.

pages.title: Delete this note?
pages.desc: Asks before a note is deleted.

pages.title: New tag
pages.desc: Name a new tag for a note.

pages.title: Week
pages.desc: Your weekly schedule: which plans and climbing days fall on which day. Home’s Today’s plan follows it.

pages.title: Plan a day
pages.desc: Pick any plans for the day, and a climbing day with an optional place.

pages.title: Plans
pages.desc: Your session plans, each with its blocks, exercises and a time estimate.

pages.title: Plan
pages.desc: A plan’s blocks and exercises with their targets and rests. Start session runs it, Edit plan changes it.

pages.title: Edit plan
pages.desc: Name, description, blocks and exercises. Reorder, remove or add exercises and set each one’s targets.

pages.title: New plan
pages.desc: The same editor, empty: name it, add a block and pick exercises.

pages.title: Add an exercise
pages.desc: Pick an exercise from the library to add to a block.

pages.title: Targets
pages.desc: Sets, reps or time, load and rest for one exercise in the plan.

pages.title: Delete plan?
pages.desc: Asks before a plan is deleted. Finished sessions keep their history.

pages.title: Exercises
pages.desc: The exercise library by category, each with its defaults.

pages.title: Edit exercise
pages.desc: Category, how it is measured and its default sets, reps or time, load and rest.

pages.title: Edit interval exercise
pages.desc: An interval exercise sets work, rest, repeats, cycles and the rest between cycles instead of reps.

pages.title: New exercise
pages.desc: The exercise editor, empty.

pages.title: Delete exercise?
pages.desc: Asks before an exercise is deleted, and says how many plans use it.

pages.title: Start a session
pages.desc: Start without a plan (a climbing day or an unplanned workout), or from one of your plans.

pages.title: Live session
pages.desc: The plan’s exercises as one list of cards with a table of sets. A rail of segments under the top bar shows each exercise and fills as sets go in. Tick a set, or change what you did first.

pages.title: A set logged
pages.desc: A finished exercise folds up. A set that beats your best earns the New best star.

pages.title: Rest in the dock
pages.desc: After a set the dock at the bottom counts the rest down with +30 s and Skip, and buzzes at the end.

pages.title: Big timer
pages.desc: Tap the dock for a big countdown with −30 s, +30 s and Skip rest. Make small returns to the dock.

pages.title: Exercise menu
pages.desc: The ⋯ on a card: change its sets, reps and rest for this session, skip the rest of it, or take it out.

pages.title: Change this exercise
pages.desc: Sets, reps or time, load and rest for this session only. Your plan stays as it is.

pages.title: Exercise timer
pages.desc: An interval exercise can start its own timer; each cycle ticks itself off as a set.

pages.title: Timer running
pages.desc: The dock counts the phases of the interval timer, with pause and skip. Tap it for the big view.

pages.title: Add to this session
pages.desc: Log a climb, add an exercise, or start an interval timer.

pages.title: Add an exercise
pages.desc: Search the library and add an exercise on the spot.

pages.title: Interval timer
pages.desc: Pick Tabata, Repeaters or your own preparation, work, rest, repeats and cycles.

pages.title: Log a climb here
pages.desc: The same Log climb form; the climb is added to the session and the journal.

pages.title: Finish session
pages.desc: Sets done, climbs and sends, how hard it felt and a note. Save it or discard the session.

pages.title: Discard this session?
pages.desc: Asks before a session is thrown away. Climbs you logged in it stay in the journal.

pages.title: Climbing day
pages.desc: A session without a plan: climbs, sends and hardest send so far, with a Log climb button.

pages.title: Session pill
pages.desc: Leave the session with the back arrow and a pill above the tab bar keeps it one tap away.

pages.title: Live notification
pages.desc: While a session runs, a notification shows progress with its next action: Set done, rest controls, interval Pause and Stop, or Log climb. On Android 16 it is a Live Update.

pages.title: Journal
pages.desc: Everything you did, newest first: climbs by place, sessions, personal records and notes. Filter by All, Climbs, Training or Notes.

pages.title: Filters
pages.desc: When, sends or not, places and note tags.

pages.title: Search
pages.desc: Search climbs, places and notes.

pages.title: Journal, Training
pages.desc: The Training filter shows sessions and personal records only.

pages.title: Session summary
pages.desc: A finished session: duration, sets done, climbs and each exercise’s sets.

pages.title: Edit session
pages.desc: Change the day, start and finish time, how hard it felt and the note.

pages.title: Pick a time
pages.desc: A clock to set when the session started or finished.

pages.title: Delete this session?
pages.desc: Asks before a finished session is deleted.

pages.title: Climbing
pages.desc: Hardest sends per scale, open projects with +1 go, sends per week and the boulder pyramid.

pages.title: Climbing, lower half
pages.desc: Sends by style and the routes pyramid by grade.

pages.title: Training
pages.desc: Weeks on plan, sessions, time trained and new bests over the last 30 days, and every exercise with its best.

pages.title: Exercise
pages.desc: One exercise: its personal record, a chart of the best set or the volume, and every day it was trained.

pages.title: Exercise, volume
pages.desc: The same chart showing volume, with a range from 3 months to all time.

pages.title: Log a result
pages.desc: Pick an exercise and enter what you did to log a result by hand.

pages.title: You
pages.desc: Climber card with days and climbs this year and your hardest sends, the consistency grid, and your personal records.

pages.title: You, menu
pages.desc: The weight tracker and the “More about you” list: Measurements, Circumferences, Notes, Places, Grade converter, Interval timer and Settings.

pages.title: Measurements
pages.desc: Weight with a chart and range, and body stats on a body outline you tap to update.

pages.title: Measurements, lower half
pages.desc: More body stats and the list of weigh-ins.

pages.title: Circumferences
pages.desc: Left and right forearm, bicep and thigh, plus chest and waist, on a body outline.

pages.title: Notes
pages.desc: Your notes with tag filters and pinned notes first.

pages.title: Places
pages.desc: Gyms, crags and boards with their climb counts, filtered by type.

pages.title: Place
pages.desc: A place: climbs logged, walls, open projects, facilities and every problem with its goes.

pages.title: Edit place
pages.desc: Name, kinds of climbing, grade scales, location and notes.

pages.title: Edit wall
pages.desc: Rename a wall and give it a photo or a map.

pages.title: Grade converter
pages.desc: Pick a system and a grade, and see it in French, YDS, Font, V and more.

pages.title: Interval timer
pages.desc: Pick Tabata, Repeaters, Max hangs or 4×4s, or set your own. Nothing is logged.

pages.title: Interval timer running
pages.desc: The phase’s colour fills the screen with big seconds, and buttons to pause, skip and go back.

pages.title: Settings
pages.desc: Grades per discipline, theme, accent colour, text size and units.

pages.title: Settings, lower half
pages.desc: Timer sounds, rest after a climb, demo mode, backups, crash reports and About.

pages.title: Backups
pages.desc: Choose what to export, import a backup, set automatic backups to a folder, or export climbs and sessions as a spreadsheet.

pages.title: About
pages.desc: Version, licence, source code and open-source libraries.

pages.title: Update a body stat
pages.desc: Tap a stat on the body outline to type or dial in a new value. Circumferences use the same dialog.

pages.title: New place
pages.desc: The place editor, empty: name, kinds of climbing, grade scales, location and notes.

pages.title: Delete place?
pages.desc: Asks before a place is deleted. Every climb and log is kept.

pages.title: Local grades
pages.desc: A place can grade in its own scale: numbers or colour tapes, easiest first, never converted to Font or French.

pages.title: Tape colour
pages.desc: Tap a tape’s swatch to pick its colour from the palette.

pages.title: Map pin
pages.desc: Search an address or move the map so the pin sits on the place. Uses OpenStreetMap, with no account or key.

pages.title: Get ready
pages.desc: A full-screen countdown before the first repeat.

pages.title: Interval timer, on its side
pages.desc: The timer works on its side too, with the big seconds beside the buttons.

pages.title: Backups, lower half
pages.desc: Photos and videos switches, and Import.

pages.title: Import backup
pages.desc: After you pick a backup file, choose what to bring in. Settings start switched off because they replace yours.

pages.title: Already in Crux
pages.desc: When something in the backup is already here, Crux shows both and asks: skip, replace or keep both.

pages.title: Photo attached
pages.desc: A photo from your gallery or the camera is copied into Crux and shown on the log. Tap it to view it.

pages.title: Photo viewer
pages.desc: The photo full screen: pinch to zoom, drag to pan.

pages.title: Video player
pages.desc: A climb’s video plays full screen. Videos are copied into Crux and are included in backups unless you switch them off.

pages.title: Light theme
pages.desc: Settings has Dark (the default), Light or System. Everything follows, accent colours included.

pages.title: Largest text
pages.desc: Text size goes up to Largest, on top of the phone’s own font size.

pages.title: Accent colour
pages.desc: Seven accent colours; the amber for goes and the green for sends stay the same in every accent.

pages.title: Home with no data
pages.desc: Before there is any data, every widget explains what will appear and how to add the first entry.
